                                                BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING
                                                    NOTICE AND AGENDA

Date: October 21, 2026
Time: 9:00 AM
Place: Board Room, Tahoe-Truckee Sanitation Agency, 13720 Butterfield Drive, Truckee, California

The Board will accept public comments on any item not listed on the agenda until the close of the public comment period. These
96160. The final mail collection will be on Monday, prior to the meeting, at 3:00 p.m.

Members of the public will have the opportunity to directly address the Agency Board of Directors concerning any item listed on the
agenda below before or during consideration of that item. To better accommodate members of the public and staff, some Agenda items
may be considered in a different order from that listed below.


I.     CALL TO ORDER
       Call to Order, Roll Call, and Pledge of Allegiance. At this time, please silence phones and other electronic devices to avoid
       disrupting the meeting.


II.    PUBLIC COMMENT
       This time is reserved for members of the public to address the Board on items not listed on the agenda. Speakers must state
       their name for the record and are limited to five (5) minutes. The Board cannot take action on non-agenda items but may
       acknowledge comments, provide brief responses, refer matters to staff, or schedule them for future consideration. Written
       statements may be submitted to the Board Clerk for inclusion in the official record.


Ill.   REVIEW AND ADOPT AGENDA
       By a majority vote of the Board, items may be removed from the agenda or addressed outside their listed order.

IV.    PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS, AWARDS, ANNIVERSARIES, AND STAFF ACKNOWLEDGMENTS
       1.     Professional Achievements - Promotions

V.     CONSENT CALENDAR
       The Consent Calendar consists of routine and recurring items that can be approved all at once with a single motion and vote.
       A Director may request that any item be removed and placed on the Regular Agenda for discussion or separate
       consideration.
       1.     Review and Approval of the Board Meeting Minutes from the Previous Month
       2.     Ratification of the Payment of General Fund Warrants

VI.    REGULAR AGENDA
       1.  Review and Approval of Agency Investment Policy
       2.     Discussion and Review of the Agency Public Outreach Program
       3.     Approval of Resolution No. 11-2026, for Commendation of Director Dale Cox for His Dedicated Service
              to the Board
       4.     Review and Comment on the Agency Board and Committee Meeting Calendar through 2027

VII. DEPARTMENT REPORTS
       Informational Updates for the Board of Directors.

       1.     Operations Department Report
       2.     Maintenance Department Report
       3.     Technical Services Department Report
       4.     Administration Department Report
       5.     General Manager's Report

VIII. BOARD OF DIRECTORS COMMENTS
       This is an opportunity for Directors to ask questions for clarification, make brief announcements or reports, provide information
       to staff, request staff to report back on a matter, or direct staff to place a matter on a subsequent agenda.


IX.    ADJOURNMENT
       The next regular Board of Directors Meeting is Wednesday, November 18, 2026.




The agenda is available for review at the T-TSA Administrative Office and the Agency website.

Emailed and Posted: 10/15/2026


Roshelle Chavez
Executive Assistant/Board Clerk


In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you are a disabled person and need a disability-related modification or
accommodation to participate in this meeting, please email Roshelle Chavez or call 530-587-2525. Requests must be made as early as
possible and at least one full business day before the start of the meeting.

Documents and materials relating to an open session agenda item provided to the T-TSA Board of Directors less than 72 hours prior to a
regular meeting will be available for public inspection and copying at the Agency's office, located at 13720 Butterfield Drive, Truckee, CA.
